long_biography.plain_text:
For Edwin Rijsterborgh, running a property company has remained a family conversation. He valued regular discussions over coffee with his father even when another businessman criticised how much time he spent doing so. His wife, Nicole, ran OfficeZ as demand for furnished workspaces grew during the pandemic, giving people an alternative to working from home.

His approach to maintaining buildings also reaches into small details. After visiting a tenant's office, he was spotted picking up litter in the car park himself. Preparing the properties for another generation has included practical upgrades such as solar panels, LED lighting and improved heating systems.
